data.one_liner: Provides over 1500 free SVG brand icons as Flutter Icons.
data.what_it_does: The simple_icons package provides a collection of over 1500 free SVG icons for popular brands formatted as Flutter Icons. It also includes `SimpleIconColors` to access the hex color associated with supported brands.
use_when: You need official brand logos or icons like GitHub, Twitter, or Discord in your app.
You want pre-packaged brand icons without managing custom SVG assets manually.
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose UI icon set rather than brand logos.
You are looking for heavily customized or multi-colored icons outside of simple brand colors.
strengths: Provides brand color constants via SimpleIconColors.
Easy installation and straightforward usage as standard Flutter Icons.
weaknesses: Limited to brand logos and popular tech icons.
Some brands may lack official color support depending on the version.

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a wider range of general-purpose icons alongside common brand icons.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a clean, modern UI icon set rather than specific brand logos.
